name: Ash
source:
Standoffish, aloof, and constantly using an apathetic attitude to cover his emotional insecurity. I'm still not sure if these are his final hair colours. Melancholy and private, Ash has some survivor's guilt over the accidental death of the last friend he got close to, and tends to keep others at arms' length. He seems to be involved with some dangerous people.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31416]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
